purpose: Collect recent Jev, decision-model and System One papers from WeChat, Zhihu, Sina Weibo and X, then verify against original arXiv records and deduplicate.
recency: Queries targeted 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-01; discovery date is not paper submission date.

added_papers_note: No paper was added from social channels directly: every formal addition this round came from the widened arXiv API re-sweep. The social round did surface the first identifier of arXiv 2610.35868 (Jev-X Cornell/ASAPP post), which proved the 2026-10-31 sweep had missed late-indexed 10-26 submissions and triggered the widened re-sweep that produced all five additions.
limitations: Sogou WeChat index and X/Twitter search are not authenticated here; coverage relies on web-search indexes and the Jev-X community index, which lags real-time posts. arXiv submissions from 2026-10-30/31 (weekend) were not yet searchable at run time (Sunday 2026-11-01 02:44 UTC, before the 20:00 ET announcement); the next sweep must re-cover 2026-10-30 forward.
